description.value: Scratch Kitchen is a North Shore artisan pizza restaurant that started in Deep Cove in 2018 and expanded to Central Lonsdale in 2024, built around made-from-scratch food using fresh, locally sourced ingredients. The menu spans creative 12-inch pizzas, sharing plates, salads, and rice bowls, with a carefully curated list of local craft beer and BC wine. Both locations offer strong plant-based and gluten-free options throughout the menu, making it a flexible stop for cyclists with dietary needs.
